findings.evidence: The published definition def-metric-compactness guarantees a finite subcover of open sets U_j; it does not return corresponding witness pairs (U_j,W_j) from P as step 3.1 claims. Step 4.1 needs those second coordinates. Add a finite-choice argument selecting one witness pair for each selected U_j, or use an index-preserving compactness formulation. This omission is immediately closable in ZF and does not require AC_ω.
